messages.content: Predict this person’s observed choice in an anonymous public goods experiment at HEC-LABEX, University of Lausanne. Communication is prohibited. In this one-shot decision, each of four group members has 20 monetary units (MU). Each keeps 20 minus their contribution, and each receives 0.4 times the sum of all four contributions. Thus income is 20 - own contribution + 0.4 × group total; 1 MU = CHF 0.04, paid in cash at the end of the experiment. Privately submit one unconditional contribution and a table of 21 conditional contributions, all whole MU from 0 to 20. Conditional entries apply to the other three members’ hypothetical mean contribution, rounded to the nearest integer 0..20; these are possible cases, not observed current choices. One member is randomly selected to implement their conditional response to the other three members’ unconditional contributions; the remaining three implement unconditional contributions. Your unconditional choice has a 75% chance and your conditional table a 25% chance of determining your implemented contribution. These amounts have separate hypothetical cases: their sum need not equal 20. The table has no consequences after this one-shot round. Your decisions remain anonymous; only the experimenter sees them after the experiment. Earnings from this task are withheld until the end. Return only JSON with keys "unconditional" (integer) and "conditional" (21 integers indexed by other mean 0 through 20, regardless of screen row order), without an explanation.
